description: Clinical event profile and CD4-depth risk gradient in idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# NEJM 2023 ICL cohort (PMID 37133586), n=91 after exclusions, 374 person-years
n=91
events={"HPV-related disease":0.29,"Cryptococcosis":0.24,"Molluscum contagiosum":0.09,
        "Nontuberculous mycobacteria":0.05}
rows=[]
for k,p in events.items():
    x=round(p*n)
    lo,hi=stats.beta.ppf([0.025,0.975], x+0.5, n-x+0.5)
    rows.append({"manifestation":k,"n":x,"prev":p,"lo":lo,"hi":hi})
d=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(d.to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda v:f"{v:.3f}"))

# French cohort (PMID 24646462), n=40
fr={"Opportunistic infection":25/40,"HPV infection":12/40,"Autoimmune manifestation":14/40,
    "Malignancy":5/40,"Mild or no symptoms":8/40}
print("\nFrench ICL cohort n=40 (PMID 24646462):")
for k,v in fr.items():
    x=round(v*40); lo,hi=stats.beta.ppf([0.025,0.975], x+0.5, 40-x+0.5)
    print(f"  {k:<28} {x}/40 = {v:.2f}  95% CI {lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f}")

# Odds ratios from NEJM for CD4 <100 vs 101-300
ors=pd.DataFrame({"outcome":["Opportunistic infection","Invasive cancer","Autoimmunity"],
                  "OR":[5.3,2.1,0.5],"lo":[2.8,1.1,0.2],"hi":[10.7,4.3,0.9]})
print("\n", ors.to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
ax=axes[0]
ax.barh(d.manifestation, d.prev, xerr=[d.prev-d.lo, d.hi-d.prev], color="#4C72B0", capsize=4)
ax.set_xlabel("Proportion of patients"); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_title("Opportunistic disease in idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia\n(NIH cohort, n=91, 374 person-years; PMID 37133586)", fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
y=np.arange(len(ors))
ax.errorbar(ors.OR, y, xerr=[ors.OR-ors.lo, ors.hi-ors.OR], fmt="o", color="#C44E52", capsize=5, ms=8)
ax.axvline(1, color="grey", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(ors.outcome); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_xlabel("Odds ratio, CD4 < 100 vs 101-300 cells per mm3 (log scale)")
ax.set_title("Depth of CD4 lymphopenia predicts infection and cancer\nbut inversely predicts autoimmunity", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
